about: Thresholds for scoring a proposal's cards, one entry per question class, in lane-check's policy shape. act_at for obvious_now is Guillaume's rule of 2026-10-09 (act when his word and the engine agree at 0.8 or above). It is a bar on a choice's confidence, (p_max - 1/n) / (1 - 1/n), not on a probability: on obvious_now's four options (questions 0.2.0 added the exit `other`) 0.8 requires a top probability of 0.85; on the three options of questions 0.1.0 it required 0.867. Each record stores top_probability beside the confidence so a bar on either number can be tried at calibration. The six trigger nouls share the class `trigger`: at or above owner_at (the coin-flip line) the card goes to 'needs you' whatever obvious_now says (Decision Gate D1), and a trigger inside uncertain_band goes there too, because an uncertain reading errs toward the person. Nothing here is calibrated from rulings yet. Revised 2026-10-26 from the Jev study of Episode 564 (R2).
set_by: Guillaume, spoken 2026-10-09 (session miadi-jev-fork1): act at high confidence with the engine, come back otherwise; applied to proposals by Mia 2026-10-10. Not calibrated: 113 cards scored, 0 rulings, counted 2026-10-26.

calibration.record_a_ruling: LANE_CHECK_LEDGER=~/.miadi/decisions/proposal-score.jsonl node $LANE_CHECK_DIR/lane-check.mjs rule <the card's obvious_now decision id> --by Guillaume --verdict act|hold|deepen|return|defer|no --words "<his words, verbatim>" [--source typed|question_box|spoken_transcribed|circle_turn]
calibration.read_the_cut: LANE_CHECK_LEDGER=~/.miadi/decisions/proposal-score.jsonl node $LANE_CHECK_DIR/lane-check.mjs calibrate reports, per class with 20 rulings, the lowest cut that agreed with him 95% of the time. It never edits this file; a person sets act_at from it and writes their name in set_by.

obvious_now.does_not_authorize: publishing, naming, deleting, opening issues or anything reaching people; do_now only lets the agent do the reversible step and report it

trigger.does_not_authorize: settling for him; a trigger at or above owner_at, or inside uncertain_band, sends the card to him with the evidence

implied_by_request.does_not_authorize: anything; kept in the ledger and off the band until twenty rulings show whether it separates

reversible.does_not_authorize: anything; kept in the ledger and off the band until twenty rulings show whether it separates

evidence_sufficient.does_not_authorize: anything; kept off the band. A false answer says the page's facts file must name more of the paths and numbers the card rests on

recommendation_sound.does_not_authorize: anything; it is read beside obvious_now
